title: VoiceStaff
subtitle: Marketing site live and healthy (19 pages, clean build). Everything behind a form or button is dead. Shortest path to sellable: DNS + auth + two keys, lean on /demo and the phone line.

items.what: Point voicestaff.pro at Vercel: add A record @ → 76.76.21.21 at Name.com
items.how: The domain is bound to the project but does not resolve (TLS fail). DO NOT touch MX records: Google Workspace runs sarah@voicestaff.pro, which is also the Supabase Pro org login.

items.what: Top up the Vapi wallet, or the demo number and web widget stay dead
items.label: dashboard.vapi.ai → Billing

items.how: The widget currently targets the MMS assistant. Fine for demos, awkward the day a VoiceStaff customer hears the MMS pitch.

items.what: Supply the money keys: Stripe live secret + publishable + webhook secret, Resend API key, production database URL

items.how: vercel env add --value, per the CLI law.

groups.name: 2 · Security Before The Database (Highest Priority)
groups.note: The moment DATABASE_URL lands, today's code makes every lead row public.

items.what: Gate GET /api/leads and /api/admin/stats behind auth BEFORE connecting the database
items.how: Both are unauthenticated today and would return the full lead list. They 500 only because no DB is attached yet. robots.txt is not access control.

items.what: Replace the dead Replit OIDC login with password-only admin auth (the MMS pattern)
items.how: This un-bricks /crm and /funnel, which currently hardcode logged-out and bounce to a 404.
It accepts any unsigned POST today.

items.what: SEO stack is genuinely solved: server-rendered metadata, OG image, 7 JSON-LD schemas, GA4 + Pixel, favicon, robots, ai.txt. All 19 pages return 200

items.how: Wrong TLD, a domain we do not own.
Not a valid US number, appears nowhere else.

items.what: Move the stale hand-written sitemap to a Next sitemap.ts with all 17 public pages
items.how: Current one has 12 URLs, lastmod 2024, and absolute URLs pointing at the dead host.

items.what: Build real Stripe checkout: create-intent route, repoint the checkout form, implement the webhook
items.how: Checkout has NEVER worked, including on Replit (the client always called a route that did not exist, and the payment route returns a mock). Product is $1,500 setup + $399/mo, so it needs a PaymentIntent plus a subscription, not a one-time charge.

items.what: Wire /contact to a real endpoint and build /api/intake, or take /intake off the site
items.how: Both forms are dead today. /demo is the only working form.

items.what: Decide the fate of /funnel and /portal: build their backends or unlink them
items.how: Fully built UIs calling 8+ endpoints that never existed anywhere. They look shippable and do nothing.

items.what: Confirm the $1,500 setup + $399/mo pricing before checkout goes live
